description:
i build cool stuff - 

one-person team behind Kalakari. The name means craftsmanship, and that’s how I like to work. IM IN LOVE with aerospace, especially spaceflight beyond the atmosphere. Astronomy is my other side chick. I am also a beginner filmmaker, so for me space is something to understand and something to tell stories about by getting deep into it.

“Abandoned but not forgotten” feels personal to me. They’re the reasons we know what we know.
